prompts.rough: A small raised wooden granary platform of mismatched planks on four stubby thick posts, knee high, with an upside-down clay pot capping each post. A crooked thatched roof sits on two poles over the platform. Rope, odd planks, a few square twine-tied hay bales on the platform. One large clear rat nibbles a grain sack at the edge. A sturdy farmer woman in a plain tunic steps up onto the platform with a sack on her back. Clear empty air under the platform. Matte straw and brown wood, no shine, no hanging cloth, a small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadows.
prompts.grand: A whole timber-framed barn with a big rust-tile gabled roof and a double door, lifted high in the air on six straight stone pillars, each pillar a plain square shaft topped by a flat, angular, sharp-cornered stone cap, not mushroom shaped, not round, not curved. The barn overhangs its pillars, wider at the top than at the bottom. Under the barn the space is clear and open: you can see the ground and the village through it, nothing fills the gap, a wooden stair rises to a landing and stops one step short of the door. A hay cart with square twine-tied bales stands under it. Fieldstone, half-timbering, matte rust tiles, rope, no shine, no hanging cloth. One large clear farmer woman at the cart. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadows.
prompts.mythic: A very long and tall timber barn with a full-height steep rust-tile roof and a big double door high up, carried far into the sky on six very tall straight stone pillars with flat, angular, sharp-cornered caps, not mushroom shaped, not curved. The top is heavy, the bottom is almost empty: a wide, clear, open gap under the barn floor, the ground and the village visible through it, kept empty and dark, no wall, no arches, no fill. Fine lines of ochre grain dots climb the pillars. Blackened oak, dark iron bands, fieldstone, matte, no shine, no gold, no hanging cloth. A tiny stone stair stops one step short of the door. One large farmer woman and one large rat share an ear of wheat at the foot of a pillar. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadows.

prompts.rough: Four thick tall round wooden posts, each pierced with a row of peg holes, standing at the corners of a stack of square twine-tied hay bales three high at most. High above, a small thatched roof sits on wooden pegs in the posts, much too high for what it shelters, an open gap of air between bales and roof. A long wooden lever with a wedge beside it. A sturdy farmer woman in a plain tunic puts one bare foot on the lever. A small lantern hangs from one peg. Matte straw and oak, no shine, no hanging cloth, no well, no bell tower. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadows.
prompts.grand: A huge long medieval stone-footed barn: fieldstone base, low stone buttresses along the side, a very steep, very long roof of rust clay tiles, a deep open cart porch. Larger than anything near it. Oak planks in the gable do not quite meet, with thin gaps between them. Asymmetric: the porch sits off-centre, one buttress is shorter. No bell tower, no steeple, no pointed church window, no cross. Matte stone and tile, no shine, no hanging cloth. One large clear farmer woman beside the porch with a square hay bale on her back. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadows.
prompts.mythic: A huge long dark oak barn nave with black oak flying buttresses and a slate roof whose ridge has split open along its whole length into one clear narrow straight slit, the two roof halves parted by a hand's width, not a wide V, no steeple, no bell tower, no pointed church arch, not symmetric. Warm ochre matte glow only along the edges of the slit, no sun, no disc, no rays, no gold. Thin matte lines of warm light show between the oak planks of the walls. Stone base, deep cart porch off-centre. Matte, no shine, no hanging cloth. One large farmer woman dancing in front of the porch, legs lifted high. A small feathered patch of ground under it, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadows.
